payload.title: Calculating Global Coherence
payload.description: This notebook demonstrates the use of the Pyleoclim library to calculate the significance and sensitivity of global coherence between insolation and oxygen isotopes from marine sediment records. It defines functions to compute maximum global coherence within a specified period band and assesses significance using AR1 surrogates. The notebook also utilizes the Climlab library to define insolation curves and calculates correlations to identify the most correlated latitude of insolation. The results are visualized through plots.
